questions.section: Questions for suppliers of spray sealing and/or line marking services
questions.text: Describe the spray sealing or line marking projects that you compete for, including the types of customers, typical contract value, and geographic area.

questions.section: Questions for suppliers of spray sealing and/or line marking services
questions.text: Explain the extent to which you compete with VSA, SprayLine, and any other suppliers of spray sealing or line marking services.

questions.section: Questions for customers of spray sealing and/or line marking services
questions.text: Which suppliers have you utilised for spray sealing and line marking in the last three years? Do you consider VSA and SprayLine to be close competitors?

Outline any concerns regarding the effect of the Acquisition on competition, including if VSA and SprayLine are close competitors and there are not many alternatives or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with VSA and SprayLine.
